title: Tempted in the Desert Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Tempted in the Desert Bible Crossword
description: Solve a temptation of Christ Bible crossword: forty days fasting, the stones and bread, the pinnacle, and “Get thee hence.” Free KJV puzzles on iOS.
prose: Led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted, he fasts forty days and forty nights, and afterward is an hungred. Tempted in the Desert covers all three temptations and the three answers, each of which is a quotation from Deuteronomy.
The puzzle is in the Hard tier because it expects the scripture behind each reply, not just the exchange. The closing verse is the tempter's opening line.

clues.text: He was set on a pinnacle of it
They came and ministered unto him

verseText: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.
